notes.title: A big content update!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/68cc5fbaa9cc855af8c5dc6d477204b2b99bb4b8.jpg

Star Crusaders!

In August 2017, we plan to release a large content add-on with more than 70 new cards – Shadow of the Council!

With the release of new cards, a new type of booster – Council, containing all the new additional cards will appear in the game. You can purchase a booster of the new type once a day using credits. The price of boosters in fracta currently stays the same.

The Vraxian booster will be removed from the game. All cards from the Vraxian add-on are available in the Core booster. If at the time of the update you have leftover Vraxian boosters, they will be converted to Core boosters.

The cost of boosters in Star Crusade has remained unchanged since the release of the project. During this time, we have added multiple new ways of obtaining credits and other game assets: Exploration mode, free Crates and Daily login bonuses. That is why, with the addition of Council booster, we made a decision to revise their cost. After the update, a Core booster will cost 200 credits, and Council booster - 300 credits. While the add-on is underway, booster prices may change.

New cards from the add-on will be available for creation for scrap with increased cost.

This list of upcoming changes is not complete. Follow the news.

See you in orbit!

notes.title: New Commander Gear Update!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/60df228d7c6dc8400912a702d49e8c10f83c17a0.jpg

Star Crusaders!

After server maintenance you will be able to change the appearance of all of your Commanders!

All Commanders will get access to 3 themed sets with 8 items in each!

All items for customizing your commanders can be found in Crates. Crates also contain other unique in-game items, including new avatars and card backs!

Types of crates:
Locked crates will be awarded to you for winning in the casual and ranked game modes. To get the reward you will have to unlock them. The rarer the crate – the longer it takes to unlock it.

At the moment, there are 3 types of crates:
• Standard (contains common items). Your scientists can unlock these in 4 hours.
• Elite (contains common and elite items). They have better security, so unlocking each takes 12 hours.
• Paragon (contains common, elite and Paragon items). These are the rarest and best protected containers - unlocking one of these crates takes 24 hours.

Unlocked crates can be purchased in the game store or received as daily login bonuses.

What can you get from crates?
• Gear for commanders
• Unique cards
• Avatars
• Card backs
• Fracta
• Boosters (including Vraxian ones)
• Tickets for raids
• Scrap
• Credits

See you in orbit!

notes.notes:
Balance changes (cards and modules):
Card: Ethereal Enlightenment
Change: Drawback
New version: You gain 1 PSYCHIC CHARGE at the end of your turn. You start with 15 less HP

Card: Forward base
Change: Mechanics, Stats
New version: ACTIVATE: give random friendly unit +1 FIREPOWER. IMPACT: lower the cost of one unit played per turn by FIREPOWER
Old version:  ACTIVATE: give random friendly unit +1 FIREPOWER. IMPACT: lower the cost of your units by FIREPOWER
New version: 3 HP
Old version: 4 HP

Card: Vraxxian Packmaster
Change: Type
New version: No type
Old version: Support

Card: Core Breacher Pods
Change: Cost
New version: 18 Energy
Old version: 15 Energy

New rules of energy gain:
Player starts with 0 energy. Maximum value is 40. Energy accumulates from the following sources:
1) The destruction of enemy units (gain energy equal to the unit’s supply cost)
2) Gain energy for damaging enemy commander by units and commanders (including weapons). Energy is obtained if a unit or the commander attacks or responds to attack with damage dealt. Other sources of damage do not bring energy: tactics, cards abilities, modules and so on. Energy increases by 1 per attack.
3) Gain energy by special cards and tactics.

notes.title: Star Crusade -- Orbital Status Update
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow Star Crusaders!

We've all been very busy here working on what seems like an endless list of features, bug fixes and improvements and I wanted to take some time to update you all on what exactly is happening in the Star Crusade universe. I'll try to make an update like this every weekend so we can keep the discussion going -- but this first one is going to be a big one, since there's a lot to talk about. 

So, here we go -- these are the things we are currently working on:

1) Modules:
We are integrating the modules for all the factions now; that includes working on the new gameplay and deck user interface, creating the new module illustrations, as well as implementing and tweaking the modules themselves. Each faction will have around 7-8 modules to choose from, and each deck can include anywhere from 1 to 3 modules, so the possibilities are already very extensive. We will also likely be releasing new modules in future expansions. It's been a long time coming, but I really think you're going to like the result -- I can't wait for you to make your own custom decks using these modules.

2) iPad support: 
The other big project we've been working on is iPad (and future iPhone) support. We will be demoing the game for the press at the Game Developers Conference in San Francisco in March, and we need it to look and feel right. On top of that, we need to implement a way to allow a user to register for the game outside of Steam (on iPad) and then to allow that user to merge profiles into one account -- since Star Crusade will be fully cross-compatible, allowing you to play from your PC or iPad using the same account.

3) Balance:
We are also working on a large balance patch, which will include dozens of cards -- no faction will be left untouched, including neutral cards, and even some Paragons will be updated (I talked about some of these in our last developer interview). We also don't exactly know what's going to happen once all you fine people get your hands on the modules, so we may do another balance patch shortly after the modules are released, to address any big unforeseen balance problems.

4) Leaderboards:
We've expanded the functionality of leaderboards, and there will be five divisions, with 100 players each. Each player will be able to track his standing, wherever he is in the leaderboards, and there will be additional rewards for climbing ranks and reaching new divisions.

5) Deck sharing and importing:
This is another feature we're very excited about -- the ability to share your decks with friends or even post to the global Star Crusade database. You will have the ability to view the newest or most popular decks, browse by faction, by type of deck, or even by deck size. Then, with the click of a button, you will be able to import the deck into your own collection. Any missing cards will show up marked in the imported deck, so you can immediately decide whether you want to create or replace the needed cards. Try out popular (or strange) new decks or just use it as a starting point in your own deck creation! 

6) GDC and PAX East show planning:
We're going to have a booth at the upcoming San Francisco Game Developers Conference on March 14th through 18th -- come join us if you're in the area -- and there is a lot to prepare. We're hoping to make a splash during GDC as we get ready for simultaneous release of the game on PC and iOS. 

We're also going to have a big presence at PAX East in Boston this year -- April 22nd through 24th! We're hoping to put together some fun for the showgoers and maybe set up a live stream from the event... also a lot to prepare. :)

A few words about our update schedule: the reason why we haven't been able to roll out the updates and fixes that we've been working on piece by piece is because everything is intertwined and heavily in development. We want to get it into your hands in good condition, so we have to test the interlocking pieces thoroughly -- separately and together. Also, we finally switched over to Unity 5 and there was a ton of work dealing with artifacts and corrections from that upgrade.

We're hoping to have most of this stuff ready before GDC, and I will keep you better updated with our progress. Thank you very much for your patience and your support as we continue development -- we appreciate it!

PS: Season three of Star Crusade ranked play is ending at 11:00 PM PST on February 29th, 2016 (10:00 AM MSK on March 1st). I will make a separate announcement regarding the season rewards.

Thanks again, and see you in orbit!

notes.title: Star Crusade Update -- Balance & Other Changes -- Thursday, January 7th
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We've rolled out a new patch, which includes new missions, many card and bug fixes, as well as a big chunk of balance changes -- please see the details below. As always, thank you all for your continued support and for playing Star Crusade! :) 

Changes: 
- added many, many new missions! (*first to post on the forums about each new completed mission gets a special bonus from me*)
- lots of updates to card text (please keep sending those bug reports and feedback/suggestions!)

Fixes: 
- Photonic Pylons no longer deploys with a phantom, non-working shield
- Mutating enemy Shan'Ti commander no longer gives that commander +2 attack on their turn
- EMP Blast can now be played on friendly units
- Disrupt Communications no longer works on weapons
- Mutagenic Growth now destroys friendly aberration at the beginning of your next turn, and not at the end of current turn
- Adrenal Overload and Entropic Organism now lower a unit's current and maximum health
- Baseline Menial can't transform into itself
- Espionage, played on an enemy unit, will now correctly draw the tactic owner's cards

Balance changes: 
- Adrenal Overload: gives a unit +4/-1 (down from +4/-2) and costs 2 supply (up from 1).
- Advanced Fabrication: supply cost is now 3 (up from 2).
- Arms Merchant: supply cost is now 5 (up from 4).
- Battle Tactician: supply cost is now 2 (down from 3); attack is now 2 (down from 3).
- Carapace Armor: supply cost is now 3 (up from 2).
- Chimera: attack is now 5 (down from 6).
- Combat Engineer: stats changed to 1/2 (from 0/4).
- Command Promotion: supply cost is now 1 (up from 0).
- Deflector Shield Operational: only activates from friendly unit being attacked (previously activated from any damage to friendly unit).
- Duskwind Guerrilas: stats changed to 2/2 (from 3/3).
- Eridani Patrol: now belongs to "general" type (was "support" type previously).
- Espionage: supply cost is now 2 (up from 1).
- Fen-Fire: now belongs to "general" type (was "support" type previously).
- Financier: supply cost is now 5 (down from 6).
- Gargoyle Bomber: now belongs to "general" type (was "support" type previously).
- Infected Militia: now belongs to "aberration" type (was "general" type previously).
- Lieutenant: supply cost is now 6 (up from 5), stats changed to 5/4 (from 5/5).
- Mobile Base Ship: supply cost is now 4 (down from 5), health changed to 4 (from 5).
- Mutagenic Growth: now adds 5 attack to target aberration (used to double attack).
- Nightmarish Visage: now lowers attacking unit's attack by 5 (up from 4).
- Nyx Hound: health is now 1 (down from 2).
- Oculus: health is now 4 (down from 5).
- Ordinance Specialist: health is now 1 (down from 2).
- Precognition: supply cost is now 2 (down from 3).
- Pulse Barrage: supply cost is now 4 (up from 3).
- Pulse Rifles: supply cost is now 4 (up from 3).
- Raging Tide: supply cost is now 7 (up from 6).
- Recycling Vats: supply cost is now 4 (up from 3).
- Reinforce: supply cost is now 3 (up from 2).
- Rocket Batteries: supply cost is now 2 (up from 1).
- Saturate Fire: now deals 2 and 1 damage (down from 2 and 2 damage).
- Signal Ops: health is now 2 (up from 1).
- Spine Spitters: can only be played now if there is an aberration under the player's control on the field.
- Symbiotic Thrall: supply cost is now 6 (up from 5), health is now 2 (down from 3).
- Titan: supply cost is now 7 (down from 8).
- Tough Hide: supply cost is now 2 (up from 1).
- Vraxxian Gunboat: health is now 4 (down from 5).


Make sure to check out our top players' streams here:
Chesspieceface @ http://www.twitch.tv/chesspieceface
ZOD @ http://www.twitch.tv/zodrot

Big thanks to Chess and ZOD for your dedication to the game! 

Chesspieceface was also kind enough to offer me an opportunity to join him on the stream for a live Q&A Star Crusade session, so stay tuned for that announcement -- hopefully, you can join us there next week!


As always, please continue to post your thoughts and suggestions about the game in the forums -- remember, we need your input to make Star Crusade the best game it can be! Thank you!

notes.title: 1.0.0.22 Update -- Thursday, December 31st -- Happy New Year!

- Disrupt Communications should no longer cancel played weapon cards
- Nullify should now correctly clear Disable effect

The season is almost over, so get out there and climb those ranks! Thanks again, and I'll see you in orbit!

notes.notes:
Season's Greetings and Happy Holidays from the Star Crusade team!

Our open beta has now been live for a whooping FOUR days, and I just wanted to pass along a very big "THANK YOU" from our entire development group to you, our kick-ass Star Crusaders!
